Hi Tessa / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Ellis Therapeutics is excited about Redwood for our clinical triage assistant pilot. Before we proceed to PO, procurement has three things they need committed in contract/DPA language:

1) An irrevocable, perpetual tenant output license for any content generated by our tenant (we need to re-distribute/annotate outputs internally and to partners).
2) A firm non-derivative/no-training guarantee: Redwood must commit that customer-provided content and generated outputs from our tenant will not be used to improve or retrain models (no-adaptive-training/no-derivatives).
3) EU-handling: logs, backups, and a delivery route for exports via an EU-hosted SFTP endpoint (eu-west-1 or equivalent) with documented proof flow for exports.

We've attached the RFI form that lists fields we consider sensitive. Can you confirm whether you can accept these commitments and share an operational path (SFTP host, encryption/KMS options, evidence collection)? Also we may ask for an onshore KMS in a later addendum — flagging now.

Appreciate a short note on these items, and happy to loop in legal if needed.

Hi all — looped in from Legal.

We've reviewed Ellis' RFI and here are the contract/operational proposals that align with our platform capabilities and certification posture: 

1) Tenant output license: we can accept language granting Ellis an irrevocable, perpetual, non-exclusive license to the outputs generated by Ellis tenant(s). We will add standard clarifying language that license covers customer usage of outputs produced from their inputs and excludes Redwood's own models/IP beyond audit/debug samples.

2) Non-derivative/no-training clause: Redwood will agree not to use customer-provided inputs or tenant-generated outputs to improve or retrain any Redwood-hosted models. We will add a limited telemetry carveout for service reliability (error rates/latency aggregates) which will be strictly aggregated and non-content-bearing; any debug exports that contain customer content will require either (a) explicit customer approval per-instance, or (b) redaction/field-level masking as agreed. Please indicate which fields in the attached RFI require redaction — we'll propose a mapping.

3) EU export path & SFTP: Operationally we can support a scheduled export to an EU-hosted SFTP (eu-west-1). Options:
   - Standard: encrypted SFTP with server-side TLS, keys managed by Redwood (we store keys encrypted in our KMS).
   - Onshore KMS: Ellis-managed customer KMS (BYOK) is available as an add-on; if selected, you retain key control and we do not have unencrypted access to export content.

4) Evidence and proof flow: we provide an audit package showing export timestamps, checksums, and transfer logs for each scheduled export. For higher-assurance requests we can provide a quarterly compliance snapshot and an ops attestation (PDF).

5) Exceptions/SLAs: If Ellis requires a contractual SLA around export completion time or proof delivery, we'll need to evaluate against committed throughput; propose to document an SLA appendix in the order form.

I'll attach a draft DPA redline and a suggested clause for no-derivative language. If Ellis confirms the redaction list for the RFI fields, we can finalize the operational playbook and provide a DocuSign-ready DPA within 48 hours.

-David
